notes: «مولى، أسماء» (the client of Asma) is named only by description, so it is kept as unnamed (doubt: the compiler's later note names him, but that note is not used)
«سمعت عمر» makes Umar a link (rule 5); the Prophet is not a link
after the saying the compiler's remarks («وفي الباب عن علي وحذيفة وأنس»، «قال أبو عيسى»، «ومولى أسماء ... اسمه عبد الله») are not isnads and are not used
